title: Five Seconds Item Remover
description: Removes dropped cobblestone, gravel, dirt, grass, and netherrack after 5 seconds
body:
# **Five Seconds Item Remover**
A lightweight, server-friendly mod that automatically removes dropped Cobblestone, Gravel, Dirt, Grass Blocks, and Netherrack after 5 seconds. Its goal is to reduce clutter and entity lag from excessive mining.
Items scheduled for removal are marked with a clear, red tooltip.

**Server Information:**
This mod can be installed on the server only. Client-side installation is optional and is only needed to display the warning tooltip. The item removal will work for all players regardless.
